platform: Linux x86-64, Ubuntu kernel 6.8.0-149-generic, rdma-core 50, .NET 10.0.15 Release
environment: KVM guests with two virtual CPUs each, software RoCE (RXE) on virtio-net, tmpfs share
workload: SMB 3.1.1 encrypted, compression disabled, two sessions. Writes include file create and close. Reads are cached. A separate read pass verifies every byte. Rates are decimal GB/s from individual runs.

measurements.topology: Two guests over a private QEMU socket link
Separate client and server processes using the same guest's RXE adapter

stress: Inter-guest transfers intermittently timed out. A six-file standard-MTU run stalled on a posted SEND with empty send and receive completion queues. Shortening the QP ACK timeout in an experimental build did not resolve the stall. On the same virtual link, upstream ib_send_bw -R -F -s 65536 -t 1 -r 8 -Q 1 -n 16000 stopped after 3132 messages and reported 120 seconds without progress.
profiling: A separate four-file, 32 MiB/file run captured four seconds of server EventPipe sampled thread time. DotNetLab's live Linux capture failed on a multi-handle wait involving a named mutex. dotnet-trace collected the trace, then DotNetLab imported it.
